speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're here with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To help me understand your condition better, can you tell me when these symptoms first started and if they appeared suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Disease (Erythema Migrans with Disseminated Infection)

I have noted your recent camping trip in Minnesota and the preceding knee pain, which suggests a tick-borne illness like Lyme disease. I am requesting an MRI of your left wrist to check for septic arthritis and to rule out other causes. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Left_Wrist
